{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Duplicate patient_id count: {len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
df_with_sentinel = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999]
print(f"Number of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {len(df_with_sentinel)}")

# Check assay_batch unit issue
print(f"Unique assay_batch values: {df['assay_batch'].unique()}")
print(f"Batch B values: {df[df['assay_batch'] == 'B']['biomarker_final'].describe()}")
print(f"Batch A values: {df[df['assay_batch'] == 'A']['biomarker_final'].describe()}")

# Check sample_seq for re-tests
print(f"Max sample_seq: {df['sample_seq'].max()}")
print(f"Number of patients with sample_seq > 1: {df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().gt(1).sum()}")

# Check arm and severity association
print(f"Arm distribution:")
print(df['arm'].value_counts())
print(f"Severity distribution:")
print(df['severity'].value_counts())
print(f"Cross-tab of arm vs severity:")
print(pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity']))"}
